title: Frequency histograms
intro: Set equal bins, trace a class and count below a cutoff.

beats.spoken: On Data and Statistics, press Tab. Select the prepared list reading on the horizontal axis.
beats.coach: On Data & Statistics, press Tab. Select the prepared list reading on the horizontal axis.

beats.spoken: Menu, Plot Type, Histogram. The vertical scale counts observations.
beats.coach: Menu, Plot Type, Histogram. The vertical scale counts observations.

beats.spoken: Open Plot Properties, Histogram Properties, Bin Settings, Equal Bin Width. Width is the interval size; alignment sets a boundary.
beats.coach: Open Plot Properties, Histogram Properties, Bin Settings, Equal Bin Width. Width is the interval size; alignment sets a boundary.

beats.spoken: Type ten for width. Tab to Alignment and type ten again. Confirm the settings.
beats.coach: Type ten for width. Tab to Alignment and type ten again. Confirm the settings.

beats.spoken: Use Analyze, Graph Trace. Press Right until you reach the class from twenty up to, but not including, thirty.
beats.coach: Use Analyze, Graph Trace. Press Right until you reach the class from twenty up to, but not including, thirty.

beats.spoken: Five observations fall here. Twenty belongs here; thirty starts the next bin.
beats.coach: Five observations fall here. Twenty belongs here; thirty starts the next bin.

beats.spoken: Add the bins that end at or below forty. The reading at forty is not included.
beats.coach: Below 40: add the three bins ending at 20, 30 and 40. 4 + 5 + 3 = 12. A reading of 40 starts the next bin.
